fields.description:
## Source of truth

Living design hub:    
https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/folder/268894210

Jira-ready requirements:    
https://jumpr.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/JK/pages/269090817/03+User+Stories+Jira+Disposition

Current design baseline: **v0.12**

## Outcome

Salesforce is the master for WagerTech Deals and Affiliate Links. CMS receives every relevant post-activation state change through one supported outbound sync service; failures are visible/recoverable; Deal identity, inactivity, Link publication and safe deletion are controlled.

## Current outbound scope

* Deal lifecycle:

    * New / Activate;
    * Paused / Inactive / Closed / Review Required;
    * Reactivate;
    * Retired / successor relationship.
    
* Date-based lifecycle tracking:

    * New Date;
    * First Activated Date;
    * latest Active / Paused / Inactive / Closed / Retired / Review Required Dates;
    * Effective End Date.
    
* First Click Date on Sign-Up, Deal Last Sign-Up First Click Date rollup, formula-qualified scheduled inactivity, and Inactive auto-reactivation.
* Makeup-key reservation/release + permanent unique External Deal ID.
* Deal + Operator/Partner + Region + currency payload.
* Affiliate Links in Deal payload including stable `link_external_id`.
* generic Link `Exclude from CMS`, CMS publication markers and safe deactivate-before-delete.
* Queueable Apex sync engine.
* byte/count-aware batching, retry, stale-response protection and error handling.
* Deal sync state, manual/bulk retry, reports/alerts.
* staging verification and production cutover.
* credentials/configuration.
* Link storage hardening (WAGR-499) before production Link publication.

## Key lifecycle / identity rules

* New is the pre-activation default and is not sent.
* Deal lifecycle fields use **Date** where same-day ordering is not required.
* Automation-managed dates/markers update only on their defined source event; unrelated edits are no-op.
* First activation queues the first eligible CMS send.
* Every payload-relevant change after First Activated requests one logical sync.
* Every post-activation Deal Status change sends the Salesforce status value as-is.
* Retired, not Replaced, is terminal for normal users.
* Makeup Key and External Deal ID are separate:

    * Makeup Key reserves the business makeup.
    * External Deal ID permanently identifies a specific Deal record once activated.
    
* Only Retired releases the raw Makeup Key:
  `{raw}-R-{18-character case-safe Salesforce Deal Id}`.
* Retirement never changes External Deal ID.
* Keep existing automatic External Deal ID collision convention for replacement records: base → `-002` → `-003`…
* No user-entered Deal Version field.
* Replacement successor cannot Activate until predecessor latest Retired/successor state is confirmed Synced.
* Legacy `United States & Canada` target Market Country is deactivated; target Deal is country-wide or one state/province.

## Deal activity / inactivity

* Sign-Up First Click Date is a **Date**.
* New SLC-created Sign-Up derives it from the UTC calendar date of source `Click_Timestamp__c`.
* Repeat clicks to the same Sign-Up do not move First Click Date in V1.
* Historical import/re-parent preserves First Click Date.
* Deal Last Sign-Up First Click Date = MAX related Sign-Up First Click Date.
* Inactivity eligibility is a Formula Checkbox:

    * baseline = later applicable Date of First Activated / Last Sign-Up First Click;
    * First Activated blank fails safe;
    * exactly N days old remains Active;
    * older than N qualifies;
    * default N = 90, configurable.
    
* Scheduled Flow sweeps formula-qualified records only; it does not query Sign-Ups.
* Inactive auto-reactivation is tied only to new Sign-Up / deliberate Deal re-parent source events and requires First Click Date ≥ Inactive Date.
* Non-live activity monitoring is V1 Formula/report based; durable status-at-arrival snapshots are deferred unless historical audit is later requested.

## Integration architecture

* **Queueable Apex is the single outbound sender.**
* Normal processing is near-real-time async request → Queueable; no normal minute-based polling loop.
* Automatic/manual/bulk/full re-sync use the same service.
* Existing CDC / External Service metadata must not become a duplicate sender.
* Hard limits: ≤200 Deals and ≤1 MB; target serialized batch ceiling ≈800 KB.
* 60-second callout timeout unless contract changes.
* CMS request/attempt/success/retry and Link publication markers use **DateTime** because same-day order matters.
* No dedicated V1 per-call Integration Log; use Deal sync state + diagnostics.
* Working V1 currency mapping: CMS `currency` ← Deal `CurrencyIsoCode`; retain as explicit WagerTech confirmation.

## Affiliate Links

* Link External ID = Deal External ID + deterministic delimiter + Link Code; stored unique External ID and never silently truncated.
* WAGR-499 hardens authoritative Tracking URL storage to support the CMS 2,048-character envelope.
* Link Code maximum remains an explicit WagerTech decision; do not silently truncate.
* Multiple Link changes for one parent Deal in one transaction → one logical parent Deal sync request.
* Lightweight Link publication markers prove last confirmed CMS state.
* Previously-published Link must be current Inactive and CMS-last-confirmed Inactive before delete/exclusion can proceed.
* Protect standard UI/list/related-list/API delete paths at the backend.
* Desired CMS omission semantics (“retain last-known inactive Link state”) remain pending Strah confirmation.

## Existing compatibility questions that do not block core build

* What “Active Deal” should mean for existing Operator/Partner/OPR DLRS/count logic after new statuses are introduced.
* Final Deal currency semantics.
* Link Code maximum / migration normalization.
* Review Required setter/use case.
* Pause Reason / Link-required-at-activation / Commercial-Terms-required-at-activation.

## Later / separate workstream

**WAGR-444 — CMS → Salesforce Deal Rep Assignments.**

WAGR-49 / WAGR-50 Link attribution remains lower priority until outbound Link identity is available to CMS.

## Out of scope

* Commercial Terms in CMS payload.
* Automated Sign-Up/DRA/Link movement between predecessor/successor Deals.
* Guided clone/replace enhancement.
* CMS → Salesforce DRA implementation (WAGR-444).

## Contract note

Older source documents may refer to Replaced, user-entered Deal Versioning, authoritative Link omission/removal, or different activity semantics. The living Confluence **v0.12** design supersedes those internal assumptions where explicitly documented; external CMS contract changes still require WagerTech/Strah confirmation.
